scene: The brass wok robot bows, offering you a glowing spice canister.
picture: A side-scrolling pixel-art factory floor. On the far left sits a huge wooden flour bin. In the centre, the young Chinese woman in her red bomber jacket and white roller skates looks right. On the right, the brass four-armed wok robot extends a glowing spice canister. Up high hangs a metal ladder leading into an exhaust chute.
